description: A two-sentence doc comment on a grader. The first sentence holds its only signpost ('differ') until the last word; the second treats the answer as a person ('must use the conversation') and makes the reader read past a colon to learn what it meant.

input.assignment: Write the doc comment for an eval grader that checks whether a research agent answered a question in the light of the conversation before it. A contributor reads it to learn what the grader measures.
